name: DCF Token sell-side burnPair reserve destruction
summary: DCF's sell path burned (amount - 5% fee) / deadCfg tokens from the PancakeSwap pair's own balance and called sync() before crediting the seller. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker bought almost all DCF out of the pair to a buy-restriction-whitelisted address, then sold DCF sized to burn the pair's remainder to dust and swapped it for the pair's USDT.
notes: Buys from the pair revert unless sender or recipient is whitelisted; the exploit drained the pair's DCF by buying to 0x16600100b04d17451a03575436b4090f6ff8f404, whitelisted by setWhite after deployment, so that exemption grant is the reset.

Loss is the pair's net USDT outflow (the attacker's flash-loaned buys net out within the tx); the pair's DCF went to the whitelisted address or was burned and is not valued separately. Flash-loan premiums and the DCF fee path's deposit into the DCT pair are not deducted.
